Getting Started¶

Requirements¶

The project is implemented with Python 3 and Django 5.2. SQLite is used by default for local development. Sphinx 9 is included in requirements.txt for building the documentation.

Install the application and documentation dependencies from the project root:

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py migrate

Run the application:

python manage.py runserver

The development email backend prints verification and notification messages in the server terminal.

Build the documentation¶

With the virtual environment activated, run this command from the project root:

sphinx-build -b html docs/source docs/build/html

Open docs/build/html/index.html in a browser to browse the generated documentation. Re-run the build after changing documentation pages or Python docstrings. The generated files are kept under docs/build/ and are ignored by Git; the source pages and Sphinx configuration remain version controlled.

Documentation format¶

Project narrative pages use reStructuredText (.rst). Python APIs are included from source docstrings by Sphinx Autodoc. Docstrings use Google-style sections such as Args and Returns; Sphinx Napoleon converts those sections into formatted documentation.

MySQL configuration¶

To use MySQL instead of SQLite, install mysqlclient and set DB_ENGINE=mysql, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, and DB_PORT in the environment before running Django commands.
